title: Xstrata Plc - proposed acquisition of Jubilee Mines NL

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Xstrata Plc, through its wholly owned subsidiary Ithaki Australia Pty Limited, proposed to acquire all of the issued shares of Jubilee Mines NL
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant market to be the market for the supply of nickel.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided that the proposed acquisition was not likely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the market for the supply of nickel. Factors which led to this conclusion included: - The market concentration of the merged entity would not be sufficient to raise competition concerns, as Xstrata represented a relatively small proportion of nickel supply; - There were sufficient alternative suppliers in the market for nickel, including Norilsk Nickel, CVRD and BHP Billiton; and - Nickel is listed on the London Metals Exchange, where its trading price is determined by international demand and supply, limiting the potential for unilateral and coordinated nickel price rises.
